edits.replace: Three answers rather than two, because a deferral of no seeds is two different facts. **Refined by [ADR-097](./ADR-097-a-rule-id-is-a-closed-union.md), 2026-09-19.** Two things this paragraph settles were still being answered from the request rather than from the payload, and the quality pass over [#449](https://github.com/chahyasantoso/motion5/issues/449) found both. A frame-only deferral answers a deferred batch, which this decision already states, and it briefly answered an empty one, because the reason was chosen from the request's own seed list once both deferred reasons required a non-empty one. A reentrant call that deferred neither a seed nor a frame booked a drain although nothing was pending, which this decision never asked for and which decision two's own sentence refuses: a booking is a claim that a drain has work. Both are read from `deferredWork` now, and the frame-only answer reports under `reentrant-flush-deferred-frame`, because the seed-carrying rule owns its ids always and a frame is not a node to name.

edits.replace: `DeferredSeeds` requires a seed list with at least one member, which makes that unrepresentable rather than merely unreached. Making it unrepresentable moved the question rather than closing it, which a quality pass over that slice found and which is recorded here because the fix is this record's mechanism rather than that one's. A reentrant call whose deferral names no seed still has to be answered, and it was answered with the empty batch, which is a claim that nothing was queued. That claim is true of a request that deferred neither a seed nor a frame and false of one that deferred a frame, so the two are told apart by what the payload owes rather than by what the request stated, and the second answers under `reentrant-flush-deferred-frame`, a rule owning no ids because a frame is not a node. This is the `observation-source` split a second time, for the same cause and with the same prefix-preserving spelling: one id was carrying two refusals, one of which has nothing to name. The same read decides the booking, so a deferral owing nothing no longer books a drain whose only act is to release its own booking. ADR-088's decision two is unchanged by either half and is what both restore.
